home.title: Welcome
home.subtitle: Mobile template — Expo, feature-based architecture.
home.cardBody: Theming, i18n, storage and navigation are wired. The API layer and the features come next.

theme.title: Token-driven theming
theme.body: One ThemeColors interface, two palettes, zero hardcoded hex in components.

i18n.title: i18n from day one
i18n.body: i18next wired to the device language, with a persisted manual override.

storage.title: Synchronous storage
storage.body: MMKV behind a facade, read on boot: no hydration flash.

navigation.title: Three layouts
navigation.body: Classic tabs, floating island or sidebar, switchable from the settings screen.

api.title: A minimal API layer
api.body: A fetch wrapper with timeouts, one normalized ApiError and parsing at the boundary.

tests.title: Tests and quality gates
tests.body: Jest, ESLint and strict TypeScript behind a single target: make check.

settings.title: Settings
settings.appearanceHint: Choose a theme, or follow the system appearance.
settings.languageHint: Choose a language, or follow the device language.

assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.intro: Start a conversation or resume one from the side panel.
